# 瑜伽師地論略纂

**ID:** T1829
**Volume:** T43
**Category:** 瑜伽部類
**Original Category:** 論疏部
**Byline:** 唐 窺基撰
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 632–682
**Juans:** 16
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1829

## Contributors
- 窺基 (A001019)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 16-fascicle exegetical compendium on the *Yúqié shī dì lùn* ([KR6n0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0001), T30n1579), composed by [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) (632–682) — Xuánzàng's chief disciple and the systematiser of the Cí'ēnzōng / Fǎxiàng 法相 school — sometime between the completion of his teacher's translation in 648 and his own death in 682. The *lüèzuǎn* 略纂 ("compendious selection") format treats the *Yogācārabhūmi* not by lemma-by-lemma gloss but by topical reorganisation, drawing out the doctrinal arguments from across the seventeen *bhūmi* and arranging them under thematic headings. It served as Kuījī's master-text for his lectures on the *Yogācārabhūmi* at the Dà Cí'ēnsì 大慈恩寺.

**Abstract**

The text is the second of [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s three major commentaries on the *Yogācārabhūmi* (alongside his lost *Yúqié shī dì lùn shū* 瑜伽師地論疏 in 100 *juǎn*, mentioned in [KR2m0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR2/KR2m/KR2m0019) *Sòng gāosēng zhuàn* T2061 j. 4). It survives complete and is the principal independent witness to Kuījī's reading of the master treatise — much of the rest is preserved only as quoted *yún* in [KR6n0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0007) *Yúqié lùn jì*. The dating bracket adopted here (660–682) reflects the period of Kuījī's most intensive teaching activity at the Dà Cí'ēnsì.

The text was widely transmitted to Sillan Korea and Heian Japan, where it became the principal text for *Hossō* 法相 lecture-courses; the *Bussho kaisetsu daijiten* 仏書解說大辭典 lists multiple Japanese sub-commentaries, including significant works by Zenju 善珠 (723–797).

[窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s exposition in T1829 is the canonical source for the Cí'ēn reading of the eight-consciousness doctrine (*bā shí* 八識), the three-nature doctrine (*sānxìng* 三性), and the systematic correlation between the *Yogācārabhūmi* path-structure and the *Vijñaptimātratā-siddhi* ([KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016), T31n1585) doctrine of consciousness-only.
